logic.scope: Deterministic inline JavaScript logic, executed in Node with explicit fixtures.

browser.scope: Real Chromium DOM; clipboard/download APIs simulated; external HTTP(S) blocked.

limits_and_behavior: At most 100,000 UTF-16 input units, 10,000 nonblank names and 256 units per name. CR/LF lines are trimmed and NFC-normalized; blank lines are ignored. Default duplicate removal is exact and case-sensitive after normalization. Keeping duplicates gives those entries additional chances and can produce identical names even without replacement. Draw 1–100 names; without replacement cannot exceed available entries. Each click starts a fresh pool. Unbiased 32-bit rejection sampling and partial Fisher–Yates use only crypto.getRandomValues in a secure context; at most 128 attempts per pick, failure aborts the whole result. No insecure fallback, saved history or server draw. This is not a certification for regulated lotteries.

visual_review.result: PASS: readable headings, fields, results, controls and feedback; no clipping observed. Screenshots are private ignored development artifacts.

limitations: Headless Chromium on Windows; not physical mobile, Safari, Firefox, screen-reader or native IME certification.
Clipboard/download mocked; no native clipboard or Save-dialog claim.
External HTTP(S) blocked; fallback CSS reviewed. Hosting/CDN delivery is separate from local input processing.
Implementation remains TESTED, not merged, deployed or publicly verified.
Installed dashboard and shortcuts are preserved; this audit makes no new native GUI launch claim.
source_identity: Connected GitHub source checkpoint and original preserved local source checkpoint have identical complete Git trees; each blob SHA was independently matched before tree creation.
